title: Article 41 — Right to work, to education and to public assistance in certain cases

content.overview: Article 41 directs the State, within its economic capacity and development, to make effective provision for securing the right to work, to education and to public assistance in cases of unemployment, old age, sickness and disablement, and in other cases of undeserved want.

sections.heading: Directive content
sections.body: Capacity-constrained directive. Education and social-security delivery is statutory. Related: Arts 21A, 45, 37.

sections.heading: Track B
sections.body: Implement through statute or scheme. Article 37 bars treating this Directive Principle as a freestanding justiciable right. Verify official text.
